summary: @ornikar/repo-config preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array rotation indirection) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into an OS temp directory, extracts and chmods the bun binary, and invokes it on the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB opaque bundle prefixed with '// @bun @bun-cjs' and contains a rotated string-array/numeric-constant table typical of javascript-obfuscator output; it is not referenced by any documented functionality of the package. Executing the payload under a separately-fetched runtime bypasses Node-based inspection of what the package actually runs on the installer's machine. The package's declared purpose is a shared commitlint/husky/prettier configuration, which does not require an alternate runtime or a 727 KB obfuscated binary blob to function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
